description: This file defines classes and enums for managing the state of asynchronous executions, including tracking status, metrics, and batch processing.

classes.name: ExecutionStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of possible execution statuses such as pending, running, succeeded, failed, etc.

classes.name: ExecutionPriority
classes.description: Enumeration of execution priorities for queue management, including low, normal, high, urgent.

classes.name: ExecutionMetrics
classes.description: Dataclass for tracking metrics and performance data of an execution, including timing, polling, network, and resource metrics.

classes.name: ExecutionState
classes.description: Dataclass representing the complete state of an asynchronous execution, including identification, status, results, errors, metrics, and polling info.

classes.name: ExecutionBatch
classes.description: Dataclass for managing a batch of execution states for efficient batch processing.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Updates the execution status and timestamps, and manages related metrics.

methods.name: set_result
methods.description: Sets the execution result and marks the execution as succeeded.

methods.name: set_error
methods.description: Records an error message and details, marking the execution as failed.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the execution with an optional reason.

methods.name: timeout_execution
methods.description: Marks the execution as timed out.

methods.name: update_poll_interval
methods.description: Updates the polling interval and schedules the next poll.

methods.name: record_poll_attempt
methods.description: Records a polling attempt, success or failure, and updates metrics.

methods.name: to_dict
methods.description: Converts the execution state to a dictionary for serialization.
